verdict.rationale: Evidence only implies user-controlled deletion: disposable, clean-baseline-per-request VMs, and a Machines REST API to manage Apps, Machines and Volumes, which suggests users can tear down compute and storage. A single community report says an account-deletion request went unanswered, which lowers confidence but does not contradict any explicit vendor claim. Missing for 10: documented data-retention policies or configurable retention windows, explicit volume/snapshot/checkpoint deletion guarantees, account or data deletion procedures, and independent corroboration.
